summary: Axvik Group AB (publ) through its subsidiaries, invests and develops specialized companies within the aerospace and defense industries in the United Kingdom, and Sweden. The company also develops and manufactures cargo loading systems for commercial aviation, including motorized loading systems certified for narrowbody aircraft. It offers the sliding carpet motorized cargo handling system. It also provides aftermarket support, spare parts, and maintenance services for its cargo handling systems; designs and manufactures advanced composite structures and subsystems for defense applications, including cannon housings, launch tubes for countermeasure systems, and missile housings for naval vessels; rudders, hydroplanes, sonar housings, and periscope housings for submarines; structural products and trim components for military and civil aircraft; custom composite structures and subsystems for fighter aircraft, unmanned aerial vehicles, helicopters, and missile programs; ejection seat components; and composite structures for air-based and ground-based countermeasure systems. In addition, the company designs and manufactures advanced composite structures and subsystems for aerospace, defense, and other technically demanding markets. It serves commercial aviation operators and the aerospace and defense industries. It provides its products through the TurnTime, Scandinavian Bellyloading, and Magic Carpet brands. Axvik Group AB (publ) was incorporated in 2025 and is based in Stockholm, Sweden.
